acceptanceCriteria: Given no carts exist, When createCarts is called with currency_code 'eur', Then a cart is created with currency_code 'eur' and an auto-generated id
Given currency_code is omitted, When createCarts is called, Then an error is thrown: Value for Cart.currency_code is required
Given inline shipping_address and billing_address objects, When the cart is created, Then both addresses are persisted and linked to the cart
Given an existing Address record, When createCarts is called with shipping_address_id and billing_address_id, Then the cart is linked to the existing address
Given inline items on create, When the cart is retrieved with the items relation, Then the items appear on the cart
Given an existing cart, When addLineItems is called with a line item, Then the item appears on the cart
Given a non-existent cart id, When addLineItems is called, Then an error is thrown: Cart with id was not found
Given quantity is omitted from the line item, When addLineItems is called, Then an error is thrown: Value for LineItem.quantity is required
Given an existing item on a cart, When updateLineItems is called by selector, by array-with-ids, or by direct id, Then matching items are updated
Given multiple selector and data pairs, When updateLineItems is called, Then all matching items are updated according to their respective data
Given items on a cart, When softDeleteLineItems is called with their ids, Then the cart's items collection is empty
Given a line item is removed, When the cart is retrieved, Then the item's adjustments and tax lines are also removed (cascade)
Given a non-existent cart id, When updateCarts is called, Then an error is thrown: Cart with id not found
Given an existing cart, When updateCarts is called with id and email, Then the cart email is updated
Given an existing cart, When updateCarts is called with a selector and data, Then the matching cart is updated
Given an existing cart, When addShippingMethods is called with a method of amount 100, Then the method appears on the cart
Given an amount of -100, When addShippingMethods is called, Then a CheckConstraintViolationException is thrown
Given an existing shipping method on a cart, When updateShippingMethods is called with new name, amount, or data, Then the method is updated
Given a shipping method on a cart, When softDeleteShippingMethods is called, Then the cart's shipping_methods collection is empty
Given a shipping method is removed, When the cart is retrieved, Then the method's adjustments and tax lines are also removed (cascade)
Given two line items on a cart, When setLineItemAdjustments is called with two adjustments, Then both adjustments are created
Given an existing adjustment, When setLineItemAdjustments is called without that id, Then the old adjustment is deleted and the new one is created (replace semantics)
Given existing adjustments, When setLineItemAdjustments is called with an empty array, Then all adjustments are removed
Given an existing adjustment, When setLineItemAdjustments is called with the existing id and a new amount, Then the adjustment is updated in place
Given existing shipping method adjustments, When setShippingMethodAdjustments is called, Then unlisted adjustments are deleted and listed ones are upserted in one transaction
Given two items on a cart, When setLineItemTaxLines is called with one tax line per item, Then tax lines are created on both items
Given existing tax lines, When setLineItemTaxLines is called without their ids, Then they are deleted and the new ones are created
Given existing tax lines, When setLineItemTaxLines is called with an empty array, Then all tax lines are removed
Given an existing tax line id with a new rate, When setLineItemTaxLines is called, Then the rate is updated in place
Given two existing tax lines on one item, When setLineItemTaxLines updates one and omits the other, Then the omitted is deleted, the matched is updated, and a new one can be created in the same call
Given shipping methods on a cart, When setShippingMethodTaxLines is called, Then existing tax lines are atomically replaced with the new set (delete unlisted, upsert listed)
Given a cart, When createCreditLines is called with an amount and external reference, Then a credit line is added to the cart
Given an existing credit line, When updateCreditLines is called, Then the credit line is updated
Given an existing credit line, When deleteCreditLines is called, Then the credit line is removed
Given an existing cart, When deleteCarts is called, Then the cart no longer appears in listCarts
Given a cart is deleted, Then its items, shipping methods, shipping_address, and billing_address are cascade-deleted

GetCart.description: Retrieve a single cart with its items, shipping methods, addresses, credit lines, and computed totals. Used by customers and automation as the primary view before mutating cart state.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Cart grand total including items, shipping, taxes, and discounts

ListCarts.description: List carts filtered by customer, region, sales channel, or completion timestamp. Used by admins or housekeeping automation to identify carts in bulk (e.g., abandoned carts to clean up).

ListLineItems.description: List line items filtered by cart, variant, or product. Used to inspect or batch-update line items independently of fetching the full cart.

ListShippingMethods.description: List shipping methods filtered by cart or shipping option. Used to inspect or batch-update shipping methods independently.

ListCreditLines.description: List credit lines filtered by cart or external reference. Used by automation/admin to find credits associated with a cart or an external source like a gift card.

Cart.description: Aggregate root representing a customer's purchase basket through its lifecycle from creation to completion or abandonment.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the cart

fields.name: regionId
fields.description: External reference to the Region the cart belongs to

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: External reference to the Customer who owns the cart

fields.name: salesChannelId
fields.description: External reference to the Sales Channel the cart originated in

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address of the cart owner

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the cart; lowercased on write

fields.name: locale
fields.description: BCP 47 locale tag preferred by the customer

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached by the integrator

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp set when the cart is converted into an order; null while the cart is still open

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Address used for shipping; replaced wholesale

fields.name: billingAddress
fields.description: Address used for billing; replaced wholesale

fields.name: items
fields.description: Line items added to the cart

fields.name: shippingMethods
fields.description: Shipping methods applied to the cart

fields.name: creditLines
fields.description: Credit lines applied to the cart from external sources (gift cards, store credit)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the cart was created; managed by the ORM

LineItem.description: Child entity within a cart capturing the selected product variant, quantity, unit price, and product/variant snapshots at the time of add.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the line item

fields.name: title
fields.description: Display name of the line item

fields.name: subtitle
fields.description: Secondary display name

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.description: URL of a small product image

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units of this item in the cart

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Price per unit at the time the item was added

fields.name: compareAtUnitPrice
fields.description: Original price per unit for strike-through display

fields.name: variantId
fields.description: External reference to the ProductVariant

fields.name: productId
fields.description: External reference to the Product

fields.name: productTitle
fields.description: Snapshot of product title at add time

fields.name: productDescription
fields.description: Snapshot of product description at add time

fields.name: productSubtitle
fields.description: Snapshot of product subtitle at add time

fields.name: productType
fields.description: Snapshot of product type label

fields.name: productTypeId
fields.description: External reference to the ProductType

fields.name: productCollection
fields.description: Snapshot of product collection

fields.name: productHandle
fields.description: Snapshot of product URL handle

fields.name: variantSku
fields.description: Snapshot of variant SKU

fields.name: variantBarcode
fields.description: Snapshot of variant barcode

fields.name: variantTitle
fields.description: Snapshot of variant title

fields.name: variantOptionValues
fields.description: Snapshot of variant option key/value pairs

fields.name: requiresShipping
fields.description: Whether the item requires physical fulfillment

fields.name: isDiscountable
fields.description: Whether promotions can apply to this item

fields.name: isGiftcard
fields.description: Whether the item is a gift card

fields.name: isTaxInclusive
fields.description: Whether unitPrice already includes tax

fields.name: isCustomPrice
fields.description: Whether the price was manually overridden

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata

fields.name: adjustments
fields.description: Discount/price adjustments applied to the line item

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description: Tax lines applied to the line item

fields.name: cartId
fields.description: Back-reference to the parent Cart this line item belongs to

ShippingMethod.description: Child entity representing a selected shipping option applied to the cart, with price and provider data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the shipping method

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the shipping option chosen for the cart

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-form structured description of the shipping method

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Price charged for the shipping method; must be >= 0

fields.name: isTaxInclusive
fields.description: Whether amount already includes tax

fields.name: shippingOptionId
fields.description: External reference to the source ShippingOption in the Fulfillment module

fields.name: data
fields.description: Opaque data forwarded to the fulfillment provider

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description: Tax lines applied to the shipping method

fields.name: adjustments
fields.description: Discount/price adjustments applied to the shipping method

fields.name: cartId
fields.description: Back-reference to the parent Cart this shipping method belongs to

CreditLine.description: Child entity representing a monetary credit applied to the cart from an external source such as a gift card or store credit.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the credit line

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Credit amount applied to the cart

fields.name: rawAmount
fields.description: Raw BigNumber JSON representation preserving full precision

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Name of the external model that issued the credit

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: ID of the external model instance that issued the credit

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata

fields.name: cartId
fields.description: Back-reference to the parent Cart this credit line is applied to

fields.name: firstName

fields.name: address2

fields.name: countryCode

fields.name: province

fields.name: phone

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata
